content:
Disney Plus and Hulu will officially become one app next month. As part of its earnings report released on Tuesday, Disney announced that bundle subscribers "will have a fully unified experience" on Disney Plus with access to Hulu's live TV service and premium streaming add-ons in December.

A unified Disney Plus and Hulu app has been a long time coming. Disney started testing its "one-app experience" in 2023, which involved putting a Hulu app tile in the Disney Plus app. This initial experience didn't include all of Hulu's content, though, including certain shows, live TV channels, and premium add-ons.
